scope: Web scrolling release to the existing QA preview. No production promotion, native app, admin product, backend or access-control change.

source.publication: Remote tree matched the staged local tree exactly before a guarded branch update.

ci.receiptProvenance: CI independently generated its full browser/frame receipts from the exact product commit. Their timestamps, samples and hashes differ from the condensed local receipt and its completeReceiptSHA256.

closeout: The QA alias remains pinned to this tested product deployment. A subsequent documentation-only commit records the hosted and CI acceptance without changing product code or moving the alias.
limits: Browser fixtures use synthetic services with real production components/media elements. Hosted checks use signed-in read-only QA UI and settled DOM observations. These are not universal physical mouse, GPU, network latency or every-browser benchmarks.
